prospects.name: SKID Systems
prospects.candidate_workflow: quote preparation, job costing, material/consumable costing, project margin tracking
evidence: full-service fabrication including engineering, cutting, fitting, welding, testing, finishing, assembly and installation
company explicitly states projects should remain within budget
prospects.why_fit: The product directly addresses quoting and job-costing pain in a fabrication operation with multiple cost components and project budgets.

prospects.name: SS Steel & Commercial Contractor Malaysia
prospects.candidate_workflow: quotation intake, rough measurement costing, fabrication/installation quote preparation, margin tracking
evidence: quote requests are explicitly handled through WhatsApp/email
workshop handles cutting, welding, fitting, coating and finishing
prospects.why_fit: The business already runs a quote-intake workflow and performs several cost-bearing fabrication steps, creating a strong fit for a structured quote and job-costing tool.

prospects.name: Ruscho
prospects.candidate_workflow: drawing/specification intake, material/quantity costing, quote preparation, production cost review
evidence: quotation process explicitly asks for 2D drawings, 3D models, material and quantity
supports prototype, repeat and production quantities
fabrication and engineering support in Selangor
prospects.why_fit: Its quote process already collects structured costing inputs, making it a strong candidate for testing a disciplined quote/job-costing workflow.

prospects.name: K.T STEEL FABRICATION
prospects.location: Taman Sungai Besi, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
prospects.candidate_workflow: job quote preparation, material/labour costing, quote follow-up and margin review
prospects.why_fit: A smaller fabrication operation with online-estimate capability is a plausible early adopter for a simple quote and profit calculator.

research_notes.priority_rule: Prefer prospects with an observable quoting workflow, fabrication activity, public contact path and a plausible reason to use a job-costing/quote tool.
research_notes.customer_claim_rule: Fresh candidates are not customers. No customer, outreach-sent, sale or revenue claim is valid until explicitly evidenced.
